hook: Every clear message answers 3 questions: Why do you exist? How does that help me? What do I do next?
direction: Golden Circle and StoryBrand merged into one one-liner framework. Prompt readers to draft theirs in the comments. Engagement play. Graphic: 3-question template card.

facebook.text:
Every clear message answers 3 questions: Why do you exist? How does that help me? What do I do next?

That's it. Simon Sinek's Golden Circle and the StoryBrand framework both point to the same truth — people don't engage with what you do until they understand why it matters to them and what step to take.

Draft your organization's one-liner in the comments using this template:

"We exist to [WHY]. We do that by [HOW]. Start by [WHAT]."

Three sentences. One clear message. See what comes out.

instagram.text:
Every clear message answers 3 questions.

1. Why do you exist?
2. How does that help me?
3. What do I do next?

Sinek's Golden Circle and StoryBrand both land here. Your audience isn't looking for your history — they're looking for a reason to care and a next step.

Try it in the comments:
"We exist to [WHY]. We do that by [HOW]. Start by [WHAT]."

Three lines. One message. Drop yours below.
